dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. What colors do you have?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈwʌt ˈkʌlərz duː juː ˈhæv?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: For this shirt? Blue, green, and black.
dialogue.reading: fər ðɪs ˈʃɜːrt? ˈbluː, ˈɡriːn, ənd ˈblæk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Do you have a red dress?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈrɛd ˈdrɛs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sorry, no. We have yellow and white.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈnoʊ. wiː ˈhæv ˈjɛloʊ ənd ˈwaɪt.
